/*****************************************************************************
Default browsercheck
******************************************************************************/
function checkBrowser(){
this.ver=navigator.appVersion
this.dom=document.getElementById?1:0
this.ie5=((this.ver.indexOf("MSIE 5")>-1 || this.ver.indexOf("MSIE 6")>-1 ||
this.ver.indexOf("MSIE 7")>-1 || this.ver.indexOf("MSIE 8")>-1 ||
this.ver.indexOf("MSIE 9")>-1) ||
(this.ver.indexOf("Trident/")>-1 && this.ver.indexOf("rv:")>-1) && this.dom)?1:0;
this.ie4=(document.all && !this.dom)?1:0;
this.ns5=(this.dom && parseInt(this.ver) >= 5) ?1:0;
this.ns4=(document.layers && !this.dom)?1:0;
this.opera=!(this.ie5 || this.ie4 || this.ns4 || this.ns5) && this.dom;
this.bw=(this.ie5 || this.ie4 || this.ns4 || this.ns5);
return this;
}

var bw = new checkBrowser();

//********************************************************************************
//** FUNCTION: makeMenuAppear
//**
//** DESCRIPTION: Causes the hidden table to remain visible. This function
//** is called when then mouse moves from the 'Menu' option in the top bar to
//** the dropdown menu that has appeared.
//**
//** PARAMETERS:
//** None
//**
//** RETURN VALUES:
//** None
//********************************************************************************
function makeMenuAppear()
{
SendMessage( "Data: Appear Called" );
if ( parent.frmMenu )
parent.frmMenu.gintEraseD = 0;
else if ( parent.parent.frmMenu )
parent.parent.frmMenu.gintEraseD = 0;
}



//********************************************************************************
//** FUNCTION: makeMenuDisappear
//**
//** DESCRIPTION: Causes the dropdown menu to disappear. This just sets the
//** table's "visibility" style to hidden.
//**
//** PARAMETERS:
//** None
//**
//** RETURN VALUES:
//** None
//********************************************************************************
function makeMenuDisappear()
{
SendMessage( "Data: Disappear Called" );

if ( parent.frmMenu )
{
parent.frmMenu.gintEraseD = 1;
setTimeout( "parent.frmMenu.checkEraseMenu()", 100 );
}
else if ( parent.parent.frmMenu )
{
parent.parent.frmMenu.gintEraseD = 1;
setTimeout( "parent.parent.frmMenu.checkEraseMenu()", 100 );
}

}



//********************************************************************************
//** FUNCTION: makeMenuDisappear
//**
//** DESCRIPTION: Causes the dropdown menu to disappear. This just sets the
//** table's "visibility" style to hidden.
//**
//** PARAMETERS:
//** None
//**
//** RETURN VALUES:
//** None
//********************************************************************************
function loadPage( rstrLocation )
{
SendMessage( "Data: Load Page Called" );

if ( parent.frmMenu )
{
parent.frmMenu.gintEraseD = 1;
parent.frmMenu.checkEraseMenu();
document.location.href = rstrLocation;
}
else if ( parent.parent.frmMenu )
{
parent.parent.frmMenu.gintEraseD = 0;
parent.parent.frmMenu.checkEraseMenu();
parent.document.location.href = rstrLocation;
}
}

<SCRIPT LANGUAGE="JavaScript">
<!--

/*********************************************************************************
** Function Name: checkWeekSpan
**
** Description: Check the timespan between the lobjElementFrom and
** lElementobjTo. Vaerify that it is not longer than 1 week
**
**
** Parameters:
** Name: lobjElementFrom
** Type: From form element
** Purpose: The input box object containing the from date
**
** Name: lobjElementFrom
** Type: From form element
** Purpose: The input box object containing the from date
**
** Name: lstrLabel
** Type: String
** Purpose: The label used for the combination of from and to text
** input boxes.
**
** Return Values:
** True: Valid week span
** False: Invalid week span
*********************************************************************************/
function checkWeekSpan( lobjElementFrom, lobjElementTo, lstrLabel )
{
var ldatFrom;
var ldatTo;
var lobjTemp;

// If no from value is specified then span is automatically too long
if ( trim( lobjElementFrom.value ) == "" )
{
alert( "Timespan greater than 1 week.\nPlease enter a valid " +
lstrLabel + "!" );
lobjElementFrom.focus();
lobjElementFrom.select();
return false;
}

// Get the from date-time
ldatFrom = new Date( lobjElementFrom.value );

// Get the To date-time
if ( lobjElementTo.value == "" )
ldatTo = new Date();
else
ldatTo = new Date( lobjElementTo.value );

// if TO date is less than FROM date then swap the values.
if ( ldatTo.valueOf() < ldatFrom.valueOf())
{
lobjTemp = new String( lobjElementFrom.value );
lobjElementFrom.value = lobjElementTo.value;
lobjElementTo.value = lobjTemp;
ldatFrom = new Date( lobjElementFrom.value );
ldatTo = new Date( lobjElementTo.value );
}

// Test timespan of 1 week
if ( ldatTo.valueOf() - ldatFrom.valueOf() > ( 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7 ) )
{
alert( "Timespan greater than 1 week (" + lstrLabel + ")" );
lobjElementFrom.focus();
lobjElementFrom.select();
return false;
}

return true;
}



/*********************************************************************************
** Function Name: goPrev()
**
** Description: Set the Start Date From and To input boxes to span the
** previous day. If there is no valid Start Date From listed then dsiplay an
** error message.
**
** Parameters:
** None
**
** Return Values:
** None
*********************************************************************************/
function goPrev()
{
// Check for no value in start date from
if ( !checkRequiredField( document.frmEORView, "StartDateFrom", "Start Date From" ))
return;
// Check for valid date
if ( !checkDate( document.frmEORView, "StartDateFrom", "Start Date From" ))
return;

// Get value of 'Start From' Date-Time
var ldatDate = new Date( document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom.value );
var lintDateTime;

// Get value of date in 'From Date' (loose time) and make this the 'To Day'
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.getFullYear(), ldatDate.getMonth(),
ldatDate.getDate());
//document.frmEORView.StartDateTo.value = ( ldatDate.getMonth() + 1 ) + "/" +
// ldatDate.getDate() + "/" + ldatDate.getFullYear();

// Subtract one day from date and set 'From Date'
lintDateTime = ldatDate.valueOf();
lintDateTime = lintDateTime - ( 1000 * 60 * 60 );
ldatDate = new Date( lintDateTime );
var x = ldatDate;
var Day = x.getDate();
Day=((Day < 10) ? "0" : "") + Day;
var Month = x.getMonth() + 1;
Month =((Month < 10) ? "0" : "") + Month;
var Year = x.getFullYear();

document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom.value = Month + "/" +
Day + "/" + Year;
document.frmEORView.StartDateTo.value = document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom.value;
}

/*********************************************************************************
** Function Name: goNext()
**
** Description: Set the Start Date From and To input boxes to span the
** next day. If there is no valid Start Date From listed then dsiplay an
** error message.
**
** Parameters:
** None
**
** Return Values:
** None
*********************************************************************************/
function goNext()
{
// Check for no value in start date from
if ( !checkRequiredField( document.frmEORView, "StartDateFrom", "Start Date From" ))
return;
// Check for valid date
if ( !checkDate( document.frmEORView, "StartDateFrom", "Start Date From" ))
return;

// Get value of 'Start From' Date-Time
var ldatDate = new Date( document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom.value );
var lintDateTime;

// Get value of date in 'From Date' (11:00 pm)
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.getFullYear(), ldatDate.getMonth(),
ldatDate.getDate(), 23, 0, 0, 0 );

// Add one day to date and set 'From Date'
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.valueOf() + ( 1000 * 60 * 60 ));
var x = ldatDate;
var Day = x.getDate();
Day=((Day < 10) ? "0" : "") + Day;
var Month = x.getMonth() + 1;
Month =((Month < 10) ? "0" : "") + Month;
var Year = x.getFullYear();

document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom.value = Month + "/" +
Day + "/" + Year;


// Add one day to from date and set 'To Date'
//ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.getFullYear(), ldatDate.getMonth(),
// ldatDate.getDate(), 23, 0, 0, 0 );
//ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.valueOf() + ( 1000 * 60 * 60 ));
//document.frmEORView.StartDateTo.value = ( ldatDate.getMonth() + 1 ) + "/" +
// ldatDate.getDate() + "/" + ldatDate.getFullYear();
document.frmEORView.StartDateTo.value = document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom.value;
}


/*********************************************************************************
** Function Name: ChangeDate()
**
** Description: set to previous or next day
**
** Parameters:
** rstrFieldName
** rstrFieldLabel
** rstrFilter go to previous or next day
**
** Return Values:
** None
*********************************************************************************/
function ChangeDate(rstrFieldName, rstrFieldLabel, rstrFilter)
{
// Check for no value in start date from
if ( !checkRequiredField( document.frmEORView, rstrFieldName, rstrFieldLabel ))
return;
// Check for valid date
if ( !checkDate( document.frmEORView, rstrFieldName, rstrFieldLabel ))
return;
var lobjValue = document.forms[ "frmEORView" ].elements[ rstrFieldName ].value;
// Get value of 'Start To' Date-Time
var ldatDate = new Date(lobjValue );
var lintDateTime;

//change to previous or next day
if (rstrFilter == "+" )
{
// Get value of date in 'From Date' (11:00 pm)
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.getFullYear(), ldatDate.getMonth(), ldatDate.getDate(), 23, 0, 0, 0 );

// Add one day to date
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.valueOf() + ( 1000 * 60 * 60 ));
}
else
{
// Get value of date (loose time)
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.getFullYear(), ldatDate.getMonth(), ldatDate.getDate());

// subtract one day from date
ldatDate = new Date( ldatDate.valueOf() - ( 1000 * 60 * 60 ));
}

var x = ldatDate;
var Day = x.getDate();
Day=((Day < 10) ? "0" : "") + Day;
var Month = x.getMonth() + 1;
Month =((Month < 10) ? "0" : "") + Month;
var Year = x.getFullYear();

document.forms[ "frmEORView" ].elements[ rstrFieldName ].value = Month + "/" + Day + "/" + Year;

}




//*********************************************************************************
//** Function Name: checkSubmit()
//**
//** Description: Check the form fields and verify that the proper data has been
//** entered. If bad data has been entered, then display an error messsage and
//** move the cursor to the appropriate field.
//**
//** Parameters:
//** None
//**
//** Return Values:
//** false: some bad data has been enetered
//** true: good data enetered.
//*********************************************************************************
function CheckSubmit()
{
if ( !checkDate( document.frmEORView, "StartDateFrom", "Start Date From" ))
return false;
else if ( !checkDate( document.frmEORView, "StartDateTo", "Start Date To" ))
return false;
else if ( !checkWeekSpan( document.frmEORView.StartDateFrom,
document.frmEORView.StartDateTo, "Start Date" ))
return false;

return true;
}

function FormatDate(i, delKey,direction) {
if (i.value.length < 10) {
if (delKey !=9) { //tab
if(delKey!=8 && delKey!=46 && delKey!=16 && !(delKey>36 && delKey<41)){ //if the delete, backspace, shift, are not the keys that caused the keyup event.
var fieldLen = i.value.length
if ((delKey >= 48 && delKey <= 57) || (delKey >= 96 && delKey <=105)) {
if (fieldLen == 2 || fieldLen == 5) {
i.value = i.value + "/";
}
} else {
if (direction == "up") {
if (i.value.length == 0) {
i.value = ""
} else {
i.value = i.value.substring(0,i.value.length-1)
}
}
}
i.focus()
}
}
}
}


function encodeValue( rstrValue )
{
var lstrParam = new String();
var lintLoop;
var lstrField


lstrField = new String( rstrValue );
for( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < lstrField.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( lstrField.substring( lintLoop, lintLoop + 1 ) == "," )
lstrParam += "%2C";
else if ( lstrField.substring( lintLoop, lintLoop + 1 ) == "#" )
lstrParam += "%23";
else if ( lstrField.substring( lintLoop, lintLoop + 1 ) == " " )
lstrParam += "+";
else
lstrParam += lstrField.substring( lintLoop, lintLoop + 1 );

}

return lstrParam;
}

//*********************************************************************************
//** Function Name: compareMachNo
//**
//** Description: Compares two values. Used in the function SetMachineNoList to
//** sort the temporary array.
//**
//** Parameters:
//** p1 : Value 1
//** p2 : Value 2
//**
//** Return Values:
//** -1 : P1 Less Than P2
//** 0 : P1 equal P2
//** 1 : P1 Greater Than P2
//*********************************************************************************
function compareMachNo( p1, p2 )
{
var lintP1;
var lintP2;

lintP1 = parseInt( p1 );
lintP2 = parseInt( p2 );

if ( lintP1 < lintP2 )
return -1;
else if ( lintP1 > lintP2 )
return 1;
else
return 0;
}



//*********************************************************************************
//** Function Name: compareMachType
//**
//** Description: Compares two values. Used in the function SetMachineNoList to
//** sort the temporary array.
//**
//** Parameters:
//** p1 : Value 1
//** p2 : Value 2
//**
//** Return Values:
//** -1 : P1 Less Than P2
//** 0 : P1 equal P2
//** 1 : P1 Greater Than P2
//*********************************************************************************
function compareMachType( p1, p2 )
{
var lstrP1;
var lstrP2;

lstrP1 = p1.text;
lstrP2 = p2.text;

if ( lstrP1 < lstrP2 )
return -1;
else if ( lstrP1 > lstrP2 )
return 1;
else
return 0;
}



//*********************************************************************************
//** Function Name: SetMachineNoList()
//**
//** Description: Load the machine number selection box with the machine numbers
//** that match the machine type currently selected
//**
//** Parameters:
//** None
//**
//** Return Values:
//** None
//*********************************************************************************
function SetMachineNoList()
{
var lintLoop;
var lintLoop2;
var lintLoop3;
var lintCurrentMachine;
var lintCurrentMachNo;
var lintCurrentData;
var larrTemp;
var lintCurrentSiteID;

lintCurrentMachine = document.forms[0].MachineType.options[
document.forms[0].MachineType.selectedIndex ].value;
lintCurrentMachNo = document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[
document.forms[0].MachineNo.selectedIndex ].value;
lintCurrentSiteID = document.forms[0].SiteID.options[ document.forms[0].SiteID.selectedIndex ].value;

for ( lintLoop = document.forms[0].MachineNo.options.length; lintLoop > -1; lintLoop-- )
document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop ] = null;

// If ALL option is selected in SiteID and Mechine Type then
if ( lintCurrentMachine == "ALL" && lintCurrentSiteID == "ALL") {
lintLoop2 = 0;
larrTemp = new Array();

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( "MCHN_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
{
lintCurrentData = String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 5 );

// Check for duplicate machine numbers
for ( lintLoop3 = 0; lintLoop3 < larrTemp.length; lintLoop3++ )
if ( larrTemp[ lintLoop3 ] == lintCurrentData )
break;

// If duplicate not found then add number temporary array
if ( lintLoop3 == larrTemp.length )
{
larrTemp[ lintLoop2 ] = lintCurrentData;
lintLoop2++;
}
}
}

// Sort Temporary array
larrTemp.sort( compareMachNo );

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < larrTemp.length; lintLoop++ )
document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop ] =
new Option( larrTemp[ lintLoop ], larrTemp[ lintLoop ]);

// If the Site ALL option is selected then find the list of Machine numbers matching the Mechine type
} else if ( lintCurrentSiteID == "ALL" )
{
var lbooGetData;
lintLoop2 = 0;
larrTemp = new Array();
lbooGetData = false;

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( "MACH_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
{
if ( "MACH_" + lintCurrentMachine == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]))
{
lbooGetData = true;
lintLoop += 1;
} else
lbooGetData = false;
}
else if ( lbooGetData == true && "MCHN_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).
substring( 0, 5 ))
{
lintCurrentData = String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 5 );

// Check for duplicate machine numbers
for ( lintLoop3 = 0; lintLoop3 < larrTemp.length; lintLoop3++ )
if ( larrTemp[ lintLoop3 ] == lintCurrentData )
break;

// If duplicate not found then add number temporary array
if ( lintLoop3 == larrTemp.length )
{
larrTemp[ lintLoop2 ] = lintCurrentData;
lintLoop2++;
}
}
}

// Sort Temporary array
larrTemp.sort( compareMachNo );

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < larrTemp.length; lintLoop++ )
document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop ] =
new Option( larrTemp[ lintLoop ], larrTemp[ lintLoop ]);

// If the ALL option is not selected then find the list of MAchine numbers matching the
} else if ( lintCurrentMachine == "ALL" ) {
lintLoop2 = 0;
larrTemp = new Array();

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
if ( String( "SITE_" + lintCurrentSiteID ) == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]))
break;

lintLoop++;
for ( ; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( "MCHN_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
{
lintCurrentData = String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 5 );

// Check for duplicate machine numbers
for ( lintLoop3 = 0; lintLoop3 < larrTemp.length; lintLoop3++ )
if ( larrTemp[ lintLoop3 ] == lintCurrentData )
break;

// If duplicate not found then add number temporary array
if ( lintLoop3 == larrTemp.length )
{
larrTemp[ lintLoop2 ] = lintCurrentData;
lintLoop2++;
}
} else if ( "SITE_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
break;
}

// Sort Temporary array
larrTemp.sort( compareMachNo );

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < larrTemp.length; lintLoop++ )
document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop ] =
new Option( larrTemp[ lintLoop ], larrTemp[ lintLoop ]);

// If the ALL option is not selected then find the list of MAchine numbers matching the
} else {

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
if ( String( "SITE_" + lintCurrentSiteID ) == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]))
break;

for ( ; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
if ( String( "MACH_" + lintCurrentMachine ) == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]))
break;

lintLoop += 2;
lintLoop2 = 0;
for ( ; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( "MCHN_" != String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
break;

lintCurrentData = String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 5 );
document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop2 ] =
new Option( lintCurrentData, lintCurrentData);
lintLoop2++;
}
}
document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop2 ] =
new Option( "ALL", "ALL");

// Search for last machine No listed
for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < this.document.forms[0].MachineNo.options.length; lintLoop++ )
if ( this.document.forms[0].MachineNo.options[ lintLoop ].value == lintCurrentMachNo )
break;

if ( lintLoop != this.document.forms[0].MachineNo.options.length )
document.forms[0].MachineNo.selectedIndex = lintLoop;
else
document.forms[0].MachineNo.selectedIndex = this.document.forms[0].
MachineNo.options.length - 1;

}



//*********************************************************************************
//** Function Name: SetMachTypeList()
//**
//** Description: Load the machine type selection box with the machine types
//** that match the site currently selected
//**
//** Parameters:
//** None
//**
//** Return Values:
//** None
//*********************************************************************************
function SetMachTypeList()
{
var lintLoop;
var lintLoop2;
var lintLoop3;
var lintCurrentMachine;
var lintCurrentSiteID;
var lintCurrentData;
var larrTemp;

lintCurrentSiteID = document.forms[0].SiteID.options[
document.forms[0].SiteID.selectedIndex ].value;
if ( document.forms[0].MachineType.selectedIndex > -1 )
{
lintCurrentMachine = document.forms[0].MachineType.options[
document.forms[0].MachineType.selectedIndex ].value;
} else
lintCurrentMachine = "ALL";

for ( lintLoop = document.forms[0].MachineType.options.length; lintLoop > -1; lintLoop-- )
document.forms[0].MachineType.options[ lintLoop ] = null;

// If the ALL option is selected then grab all numbers from the MachineNo array and put them
// in the option box
if ( lintCurrentSiteID == "ALL" )
{
lintLoop2 = 0;
larrTemp = new Array();
for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( "MACH_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
{
// Check for duplicate machine numbers
for ( lintLoop3 = 0; lintLoop3 < larrTemp.length; lintLoop3++ )
if ( larrTemp[ lintLoop3 ].value == String(garrMachineTypeNo[
lintLoop ]).substring( 5 ))
break;

// If duplicate not found then add number temporary array
if ( lintLoop3 == larrTemp.length )
{
larrTemp[ lintLoop2 ] = new Option(
String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop + 1 ]).substring( 5 ),
String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ] ).substring( 5 ));
lintLoop2++;
}
}
}

// Sort Temporary array
larrTemp.sort(compareMachType);

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < larrTemp.length; lintLoop++ )
document.forms[0].MachineType.options[ lintLoop ] = larrTemp[ lintLoop ];

// If the ALL option is not selected then find the list of Machine Types matching the Site ID
} else {

for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
if ( String( "SITE_" + lintCurrentSiteID ) == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]))
break;

lintLoop++;
lintLoop2 = 0;
for ( ; lintLoop < garrMachineTypeNo.length; lintLoop++ )
{
if ( "SITE_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
break;

if ( "MACH_" == String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ]).substring( 0, 5 ))
{
document.forms[0].MachineType.options[ lintLoop2 ] =
new Option( String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop + 1 ]).substring( 5 ),
String( garrMachineTypeNo[ lintLoop ] ).substring( 5 ));
lintLoop2++;
}
}
}
document.forms[0].MachineType.options[ lintLoop2 ] =
new Option( "ALL", "ALL");

// Search for last machine type listed
for ( lintLoop = 0; lintLoop < this.document.forms[0].MachineType.options.length; lintLoop++ )
if ( this.document.forms[0].MachineType.options[ lintLoop ].value == lintCurrentMachine )
break;
if ( lintLoop != this.document.forms[0].MachineType.options.length )
document.forms[0].MachineType.selectedIndex = lintLoop;
else
document.forms[0].MachineType.selectedIndex = this.document.forms[0].
MachineType.options.length - 1;
SetMachineNoList();
}




//*********************************************************************************
//** Function Name: SetSiteList()
//**
//** Description: Load the Site selection box with the ActiveSites
//** when the check box is currently selected
//**
//** Parameters:
//** None
//**
//** Return Values:
//** None
//*********************************************************************************

function SetSiteList()
{
var lActiveInd;
var lintLoop;
var i ;
var j ;

lActiveInd = document.forms[0].elements["ActiveSites"].checked;

for ( lintLoop = document.forms[0].SiteID.options.length; lintLoop > -1; lintLoop-- )
document.forms[0].SiteID.options[ lintLoop ] = null;

j = 0;
document.forms[0].SiteID.options[j] =
new Option( "ALL", "ALL");
//It Loads the Site selection box with the ActiveSites when Active Sites checkbox is checked


if (lActiveInd)
{
j = 1;
for (i = 0; i < garrActiveSites.length; i++ )
{
document.forms[0].SiteID.options[j] =
new Option( garrActiveSites[i+1], garrActiveSites[i]);
i++;
j++;
}

document.forms[0].elements["Active"].value = "TRUE";
}
else
//It Loads the Site selection box with the InActiveSite,Active when Active Sites checkbox is unchecked
{
j = 1;
for (i = 0; i < garrAllSites.length; i++ )
{
document.forms[0].SiteID.options[j] =
new Option( garrAllSites[i+1], garrAllSites[i]);
i++;
j++;
}
document.forms[0].elements["Active"].value = "FALSE";
}
}

substr(TO_CHAR(application_data.start_dtm, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI'), 7, 2) sYear, substr(TO_CHAR(application_data.end_dtm, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI'), 7, 2) eYear, NVL(substr(TO_CHAR(application_data.mods_trans_date), 9, 2), '00') mTransYear, postal_facility.site_name FROM EOR_PSBRPA.application_data, EOR_PSBRPA.end_of_run, ( SELECT site_id, site_name, zip_code_id FROM EOR_PSBRPA.postal_facility x START WITH x.site_id = 19010 CONNECT BY PRIOR x.site_id = x.parent_site_id AND x.site_id \x3C> 19010 ) postal_facility, EOR_PSBRPA.machine_type, EOR_PSBRPA.machine WHERE end_of_run.site_id = postal_facility.site_id AND end_of_run.machine_id = machine.machine_id AND end_of_run.site_id = machine.site_id AND end_of_run.run_mach_type_code = machine_type.mach_type_code AND end_of_run.run_sequence_nbr = application_data.run_sequence_nbr AND application_data.mods_date >= TO_DATE('17-Oct-2026', 'DD-MON-YYYY') AND application_data.mods_date \x3C= TO_DATE('17-Oct-2026', 'DD-MON-YYYY') ORDER BY mach_type_desc asc, machine_nbr asc, myear asc, syear asc, start_date asc";
</SCRIPT>
